tickets.name: Regular Ticket
tickets.body: Your way into the full Coco Bongo night: the show kicks off at 9:00 PM (the schedule may vary by season), then the party takes over. You're on the main floor, the lower level, right in the crowd where the dancing happens, with standard access and standing room (no reserved seat). The unlimited open bar pours domestic drinks from the standard menu from 8:00 PM to 1:00 AM, and you get 1 snack per person: a mini burger, hot dog, tequeños or mini sandwich, all served with French fries. Round-trip hotel transport is included; the tip isn't.
tickets.who: Groups of friends and first-timers who want to dance and feel the energy up close for the lowest price.

tickets.name: Premium
tickets.body: The same main-floor spot, standard access and full show and party as the Regular Ticket, with a better bar: the unlimited open bar moves up to the premium menu from 8:00 PM to 1:00 AM. It's still standing room, with no fast entry and no reserved seat. Your snack is included too: a mini burger, hot dog, tequeños or mini sandwich, all served with French fries. Round-trip hotel transport is included; the tip isn't.
tickets.who: Guests who want to be on the dance floor but care about what's in the glass.

tickets.name: Gold Member
tickets.body: Walk in through the VIP entrance with expedited access and head upstairs to the Gold Member VIP area, where reserved VIP seating is waiting for you (the Front Row seats are separate). You watch the acrobats and tributes from above, with room to sit between songs and get up to dance when you want. The unlimited open bar pours from the premium menu from 8:00 PM to 1:00 AM, and your snack is included: a mini burger, hot dog, tequeños or mini sandwich, all served with French fries. Round-trip hotel transport is included; the tip isn't.
tickets.who: Couples, birthdays and anyone who wants a reserved seat and a less crowded spot for a show that runs late into the night.

tickets.name: Front Row
tickets.body: The front row of the Gold Member VIP area, with unobstructed visibility of the performers and the aerial acts. You get the VIP entrance and expedited access, personalized assistance and service through the night, the unlimited premium open bar from 8:00 PM to 1:00 AM and your snack: a mini burger, hot dog, tequeños or mini sandwich, all served with French fries. Seats aren't pre-assigned: on arrival, staff seat you in the front row according to the zone map. Round-trip hotel transport is included; the tip isn't.
tickets.who: Proposals, anniversaries, bachelor and bachelorette parties, and anyone who wants an unobstructed view of the show.
